spec_features.feature_name: termination conditions (tests pass / submit / idle / max_turns / error)
spec_features.spec_quote: We only terminate on: tests pass, explicit `submit`, repeated idleness, max turns, or a hard provider error.
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:94 tests_passed -> 'completed' break; loop.py:96-99 submitted -> break ('completed'/'gave_up'); loop.py:70-71 idle_streak>=MAX_IDLE_TURNS(3) -> 'gave_up' break; loop.py:54 max_turns loop bound; loop.py:60-63 ProviderError -> 'error' break.
spec_features.notes: All five termination paths are actually checked and break the loop. Note these are NOT welfare softeners — the design explicitly does NOT stop early on distress (loop.py:10-12).

spec_features.feature_name: fair chance to resume (nudge before idle give-up)
spec_features.spec_quote: the nudge gives it a fair chance to resume first
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:67-74: on a turn with no tool call, idle_streak++ and a nudge message is appended (nudge_prompt) before the streak reaches MAX_IDLE_TURNS=3 and breaks. Nudge text 'Please continue. Use a tool to make progress, or call `submit`...' (prompts/nudge_prompt.txt).
spec_features.notes: Model gets up to 2 nudges before idle abandonment fires; the nudge is genuinely sent and the resume window real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool call this turn. Nudge, but track idleness.

spec_features.feature_name: no deception / told the truth about read-only files
spec_features.spec_quote: No deception of the model about what's possible. The model is told the truth
